     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Descent.QuasiProjectiveFiniteInAffine
     7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0FiniteStageGluedOver
     8	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0GaloisAction
     9	
    10	/-!
    11	# Orbit affineness for the finite-stage Picard glue
    12	
    13	An immersion of the finite-stage glued representative into finite relative projective space
    14	gives the finite-in-affine property, so every orbit of its canonical finite-Galois action lies
    15	in an affine open.  This file records both producers at the exact carrier `P.gluedOver` used by
    16	finite-stage descent.  The projectivity entry point remains as a compatibility wrapper.
    17	-/
    18	
    19	set_option autoImplicit false
    20	
    21	universe u
    22	
    23	open CategoryTheory
    24	open AlgebraicJacobian.GaloisDescent
    25	
    26	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    27	
    28	noncomputable section
    29	
    30	variable {K k F : Type u} [Field K] [Field k] [Field F]
    31	variable [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k]
    32	variable (C : Over (Spec (.of K)))
    33	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    34	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    35	variable (Ck : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    36	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 Ck.hom] [IsProper Ck.hom]
    37	  [GeometricallyIrreducible Ck.hom] [IsSepClosed k]
    38	
    39	/-- A finite-dimensional projective-space immersion makes the finite-stage glue
    40	`FiniteInAffine`. -/
    41	theorem pic0FiniteStageFiniteInAffine_of_isImmersion
    42	    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage Ck F)
    43	    {n : Type u} [Finite n]
    44	    (i : P.glueData.glued ⟶ ℙ(n; Spec (.of P.N.1)))
    45	    (hi : IsImmersion i) :
    46	    Scheme.FiniteInAffine P.glueData.glued := by
    47	  letI : IsImmersion i := hi
    48	  exact Scheme.finiteInAffine_of_isImmersion i
    49	    (Scheme.finiteInAffine_projectiveSpace n (Spec (.of P.N.1)))
    50	
    51	/-- A finite-dimensional projective-space immersion supplies orbit affineness for the
    52	canonical action attached to a representation of Picard zero by the finite-stage glue. -/
    53	@[implicit_reducible]
    54	noncomputable def pic0FiniteStageOrbitsInAffineOpen_of_isImmersion
    55	    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage Ck F)
    56	    [Algebra K P.N.1] [FiniteDimensional K P.N.1] [IsGalois K P.N.1]
    57	    (rep : (pic0TypeFunctor ((baseChange K P.N.1).obj C)).RepresentableBy P.gluedOver)
    58	    {n : Type u} [Finite n]
    59	    (i : P.glueData.glued ⟶ ℙ(n; Spec (.of P.N.1)))
    60	    (hi : IsImmersion i) :
    61	    (pic0SemilinearGalActionOfRepresentableBy C rep).OrbitsInAffineOpen :=
    62	  Scheme.orbitsInAffineOpen_of_finiteInAffine _
    63	    (pic0FiniteStageFiniteInAffine_of_isImmersion Ck P i hi)
    64	
    65	/-- Compatibility wrapper deriving the immersion input from projectivity of the finite-stage
    66	glued morphism. -/
    67	@[implicit_reducible]
    68	noncomputable def pic0FiniteStageOrbitsInAffineOpen_of_isProjective
    69	    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage Ck F)
    70	    [Algebra K P.N.1] [FiniteDimensional K P.N.1] [IsGalois K P.N.1]
    71	    (rep : (pic0TypeFunctor ((baseChange K P.N.1).obj C)).RepresentableBy P.gluedOver)
    72	    (hproj : P.gluedMap.IsProjective) :
    73	    (pic0SemilinearGalActionOfRepresentableBy C rep).OrbitsInAffineOpen := by
    74	  obtain ⟨n, hn, i, hi, -⟩ := hproj
    75	  letI : Finite n := hn
    76	  letI : IsClosedImmersion i := hi
    77	  exact pic0FiniteStageOrbitsInAffineOpen_of_isImmersion C Ck P rep i
    78	    (inferInstance : IsImmersion i)
    79	
    80	end

     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage
     7	
     8	/-!
     9	# The finite-stage Picard glue as a scheme over its field of definition
    10	
    11	The finite-stage glue package already contains affine algebras over its final finite
    12	subextension `P.N.1`.  Their structure maps agree on overlaps, so they descend to the
    13	glued scheme.  This retains the finite-stage object over `Spec P.N.1`, which is the
    14	object-level input for the scalar-extension comparison with the separably closed atlas.
    15	-/
    16	
    17	set_option autoImplicit false
    18	
    19	universe u
    20	
    21	open CategoryTheory Limits TensorProduct
    22	open scoped TensorProduct
    23	
    24	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    25	
    26	noncomputable section
    27	
    28	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    29	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    30	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [IsSepClosed k]
    31	
    32	namespace Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage
    33	
    34	set_option linter.style.setOption false
    35	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 3200000 in
    36	-- Projecting the dependent scalar towers from `P` requires a larger local synthesis budget.
    37	set_option maxHeartbeats 12800000 in
    38	/-- The structure map from the finite-stage glued scheme to its field of definition. -/
    39	noncomputable def gluedMap
    40	    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k]
    41	    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage C F) :
    42	    P.glueData.glued ⟶ Spec (.of P.N.1) := by
    43	  letI : Algebra.IsAlgebraic P.L.1 k := by infer_instance
    44	  letI : Algebra.IsAlgebraic P.M.1 k := by infer_instance
    45	  let A : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C -> Type u := fun U =>
    46	    Pic0FiniteStageChartBaseChangeRing C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.N U
    47	  let B : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C -> Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C -> Type u :=
    48	    fun U V =>
    49	      Pic0FiniteStageOverlapBaseChangeRing C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.N U V
    50	  let r : ∀ U V, A U →ₐ[P.N.1] B U V := fun U V =>
    51	    pic0FiniteStageRestrictionBaseChange
    52	      C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.mapM P.N U V
    53	  letI : ∀ U V, Algebra (A U) (B U V) := fun U V =>
    54	    pic0FiniteStageAlgebraOfMap (r U V)
    55	  letI : ∀ U V, IsScalarTower P.N.1 (A U) (B U V) := fun U V =>
    56	    pic0FiniteStageTowerOfMap (r U V)
    57	  let tau : ∀ U V, B V U →ₐ[P.N.1] B U V := fun U V =>
    58	    pic0FiniteStageTransitionBaseChange
    59	      C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.mapM P.N U V
    60	  fapply Multicoequalizer.desc
    61	  · intro U
    62	    change Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C at U
    63	    exact Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.N.1 (A U)))
    64	  · rintro ⟨U, V⟩
    65	    change Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C at U V
    66	    change
    67	      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (A U) (B U V))) ≫
    68	          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.N.1 (A U))) =
    69	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (tau U V).toRingHom) ≫
    70	          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (A V) (B V U)))) ≫
    71	            Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.N.1 (A V)))
    72	    rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
    73	    rw [Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
    74	    rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
    75	    congr 1
    76	    ext x
    77	    simp only [CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, CommRingCat.hom_comp,
    78	      ConcreteCategory.hom_ofHom, RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply,
    79	      AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, Category.assoc, RingHom.coe_coe]
    80	    rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply P.N.1 (A U) (B U V)]
    81	    rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply P.N.1 (A V) (B V U)]
    82	    exact (tau U V).commutes x |>.symm
    83	
    84	/-- The finite-stage Picard glue, retained over the finite field `P.N.1`. -/
    85	noncomputable def gluedOver
    86	    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k]
    87	    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage C F) : Over (Spec (.of P.N.1)) :=
    88	  Over.mk P.gluedMap
    89	
    90	end Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage
    91	
    92	end
    93	
    94	end AlgebraicGeometry

     7	
     8	/-!
     9	# Basic geometry of the finite-stage Picard glue
    10	
    11	The finite-stage glue is covered by finitely many affine spectra of explicit
    12	finite-presentation algebras over its field of definition.  Consequently its structure
    13	morphism is locally of finite type and quasi-compact, without any additional geometric
    14	hypothesis on the package.
    15	-/
    16	
    17	set_option autoImplicit false
    18	
    19	universe u
    20	
    21	open CategoryTheory
    22	
    23	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    24	
    25	noncomputable section
    26	
    27	variable {k F : Type u} [Field k] [Field F]
    28	variable [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k]
    29	variable (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    30	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    31	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [IsSepClosed k]
    32	
    33	namespace Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage
    34	
    35	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 3200000 in
    36	-- The chart rings retain two nested finite-subextension tensor products.
    37	set_option maxHeartbeats 12800000 in
    38	/-- The structure morphism of the finite-stage Picard glue is locally of finite type. -/
    39	theorem locallyOfFiniteType_gluedMap
    40	    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage C F) :
    41	    LocallyOfFiniteType P.gluedMap := by
    42	  apply IsZariskiLocalAtSource.of_openCover P.glueData.openCover
    43	  intro U
    44	  change LocallyOfFiniteType (P.glueData.ι U ≫ P.gluedMap)
    45	  rw [glueData_ι_gluedMap C P U]
    46	  exact (HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff (P := @LocallyOfFiniteType)).mpr
    47	    (RingHom.finiteType_algebraMap.mpr inferInstance)
    48	
    49	instance instLocallyOfFiniteTypeGluedMap
    50	    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage C F) :
    51	    LocallyOfFiniteType P.gluedMap :=
    52	  locallyOfFiniteType_gluedMap C P
    53	
    54	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 3200000 in
    55	-- Unfolding the dependent affine glue identifies its finite spectrum charts.
    56	set_option maxHeartbeats 12800000 in
    57	/-- The structure morphism of the finite-stage Picard glue is quasi-compact. -/
    58	theorem quasiCompact_gluedMap
    59	    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage C F) :
    60	    QuasiCompact P.gluedMap := by
    61	  haveI : Finite P.glueData.openCover.I₀ := by
    62	    change Finite (Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C)
    63	    infer_instance
    64	  haveI : ∀ U, CompactSpace (P.glueData.openCover.X U) := by
    65	    intro U
    66	    change CompactSpace
    67	      (Spec (CommRingCat.of
    68	        (Pic0FiniteStageChartBaseChangeRing
    69	          C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.N U)))
    70	    infer_instance
    71	  haveI : CompactSpace P.glueData.glued :=
    72	    P.glueData.openCover.compactSpace
    73	  exact (HasAffineProperty.iff_of_isAffine (P := @QuasiCompact)).mpr
    74	    (inferInstance : CompactSpace P.glueData.glued)
    75	
    76	instance instQuasiCompactGluedMap
    77	    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage C F) :
    78	    QuasiCompact P.gluedMap :=
    79	  quasiCompact_gluedMap C P
    80	
    81	end Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage

    84

     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Descent.GaloisQuotientOverlap
     7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0GaloisAction
     8	
     9	/-!
    10	# The quotient-side bridge for finite Galois descent of Picard zero
    11	
    12	A specified finite Galois quotient represents equivariant maps after base
    13	change.  This file records that statement in the over-category.  It is the
    14	scheme-theoretic half of descending a representative of `pic0TypeFunctor`.
    15	-/
    16	
    17	set_option autoImplicit false
    18	
    19	universe u
    20	
    21	open CategoryTheory Limits
    22	open AlgebraicGeometry
    23	
    24	namespace AlgebraicJacobian.GaloisDescent
    25	
    26	/-- An equivariant map from the finite-Galois base change of an object over
    27	`Spec K` to a semilinearly acted `L`-scheme. -/
    28	structure GaloisEquivariantOver
    29	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    30	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
    31	    (rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f)
    32	    (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))) where
    33	  hom : pullback T.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) ⟶ X
    34	  commutes : hom ≫ f =
    35	    pullback.snd T.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))
    36	  equivariant : (pullbackSemilinearGalAction K L T.hom).IsEquivariant rho hom
    37	
    38	namespace GaloisEquivariantOver
    39	
    40	variable {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    41	  {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
    42	  (rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f)
    43	
    44	/-- Pull an equivariant map back along a morphism over `Spec K`. -/
    45	noncomputable def precomp
    46	    {T T' : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))} (a : T' ⟶ T)
    47	    (h : GaloisEquivariantOver rho T) : GaloisEquivariantOver rho T' where
    48	  hom := pullbackBaseChange K L T.hom T'.hom a.left a.w ≫ h.hom
    49	  commutes := by
    50	    rw [Category.assoc, h.commutes, pullbackBaseChange_snd]
    51	  equivariant := SemilinearGalAction.isEquivariant_pullbackBaseChange_comp
    52	    T.hom T'.hom rho h.equivariant a.left a.w
    53	
    54	@[ext]
    55	theorem ext {T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))}
    56	    {h h' : GaloisEquivariantOver rho T} (hh : h.hom = h'.hom) : h = h' := by
    57	  cases h
    58	  cases h'
    59	  cases hh
    60	  rfl
    61	
    62	end GaloisEquivariantOver
    63	
    64	namespace GaloisQuotientWitness
    65	
    66	variable {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    67	  {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
    68	  {rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f}
    69	  {Y : Scheme.{u}} {g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
    70	
    71	/-- A finite-Galois quotient witness represents equivariant maps after base
    72	change, with no affineness assumption on the test object. -/
    73	noncomputable def overHomEquiv (w : GaloisQuotientWitness rho Y g)
    74	    (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))) :
    75	    (T ⟶ Over.mk g) ≃ GaloisEquivariantOver rho T where
    76	  toFun a :=
    77	    { hom := pullbackBaseChange K L g T.hom a.left a.w ≫ w.e.hom
    78	      commutes := by
    79	        rw [Category.assoc, w.over, pullbackBaseChange_snd]
    80	      equivariant := SemilinearGalAction.isEquivariant_pullbackBaseChange_comp
    81	        g T.hom rho w.equivariant a.left a.w }
    82	  invFun h :=
    83	    Over.homMk
    84	      (w.universal T.left T.hom h.hom h.commutes h.equivariant).choose.1
    85	      (w.universal T.left T.hom h.hom h.commutes h.equivariant).choose.2
    86	  left_inv a := by
    87	    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    88	    let h := pullbackBaseChange K L g T.hom a.left a.w ≫ w.e.hom
    89	    let hw := w.universal T.left T.hom h
    90	      (by
    91	        dsimp [h]
    92	        rw [Category.assoc, w.over, pullbackBaseChange_snd])
    93	      (by
    94	        dsimp [h]
    95	        exact SemilinearGalAction.isEquivariant_pullbackBaseChange_comp
    96	          g T.hom rho w.equivariant a.left a.w)
    97	    have ha : pullbackBaseChange K L g T.hom a.left a.w ≫ w.e.hom = h := rfl
    98	    have heq : hw.choose = ⟨a.left, a.w⟩ :=
    99	      hw.unique hw.choose_spec.1 ha
   100	    exact congrArg Subtype.val heq
   101	  right_inv h := by
   102	    apply GaloisEquivariantOver.ext rho
   103	    exact (w.universal T.left T.hom h.hom h.commutes h.equivariant).choose_spec.1
   104	
   105	/-- The quotient universal-property equivalence commutes with precomposition
   106	in the category of schemes over `Spec K`. -/
   107	theorem overHomEquiv_precomp (w : GaloisQuotientWitness rho Y g)
   108	    {T T' : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))} (a : T' ⟶ T)
   109	    (b : T ⟶ Over.mk g) :
   110	    w.overHomEquiv T' (a ≫ b) =
   111	      GaloisEquivariantOver.precomp rho a (w.overHomEquiv T b) := by
   112	  apply GaloisEquivariantOver.ext rho
   113	  change pullbackBaseChange K L g T'.hom (a.left ≫ b.left) _ ≫ w.e.hom =
   114	    pullbackBaseChange K L T.hom T'.hom a.left a.w ≫
   115	      (pullbackBaseChange K L g T.hom b.left b.w ≫ w.e.hom)
   116	  rw [pullbackBaseChange_comp K L g T.hom T'.hom b.left b.w a.left a.w,
   117	    Category.assoc]
   118	
   119	end GaloisQuotientWitness
   120	
   121	namespace StableAffineOpen
   122	
   123	variable {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
   124	  {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
   125	  (rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f)
   126	
   127	/-- Under the orbit-in-an-affine-open hypothesis, the glued invariant-ring
   128	quotient represents equivariant maps after finite Galois base change. -/
   129	noncomputable def gluedQuotientOverHomEquiv
   130	    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L] [rho.OrbitsInAffineOpen]
   131	    (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))) :
   132	    (T ⟶ gluedQuotientOver rho) ≃ GaloisEquivariantOver rho T :=
   133	  (gluedGaloisQuotientWitness rho).toGaloisQuotientWitness.overHomEquiv T
   134	
   135	/-- The glued-quotient equivalence is natural under precomposition. -/
   136	theorem gluedQuotientOverHomEquiv_precomp
   137	    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L] [rho.OrbitsInAffineOpen]
   138	    {T T' : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))} (a : T' ⟶ T)
   139	    (b : T ⟶ gluedQuotientOver rho) :
   140	    gluedQuotientOverHomEquiv rho T' (a ≫ b) =
   141	      GaloisEquivariantOver.precomp rho a (gluedQuotientOverHomEquiv rho T b) :=
   142	  GaloisQuotientWitness.overHomEquiv_precomp
   143	    (gluedGaloisQuotientWitness rho).toGaloisQuotientWitness a b
   144	
   145	end StableAffineOpen
   146	
   147	end AlgebraicJacobian.GaloisDescent

     8	/-!

    10	
    11	This is a conditional producer: it descends a finite-level representative only
    12	under the explicitly supplied orbit-in-an-affine-open instance.  It is not the
    13	arbitrary-field representability endpoint.
    14	-/

    17	
    18	universe u
    19	
    20	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite
    21	open AlgebraicGeometry
    22	open AlgebraicJacobian.GaloisDescent

    25	
    26	noncomputable section
    27

    29	
    30	/-- Conditional finite-Galois descent of a finite-level Picard-zero representative.
    31	
    32	The orbit-in-an-affine-open instance is the sole extra descent hypothesis here;
    33	this theorem does not claim arbitrary-field representability.
    34	-/
    35	noncomputable def pic0RepresentableBy_finiteGaloisDescent
    36	    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)))
    37	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    38	    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    39	    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    40	    {J : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of L))}
    41	    (rep : (pic0TypeFunctor ((baseChange K L).obj C)).RepresentableBy J)
    42	    [((pic0SemilinearGalActionOfRepresentableBy C rep).OrbitsInAffineOpen)] :
    43	    (pic0TypeFunctor C).RepresentableBy
    44	      (AlgebraicJacobian.GaloisDescent.StableAffineOpen.gluedQuotientOver
    45	        (pic0SemilinearGalActionOfRepresentableBy C rep)) where
    46	  homEquiv {T} :=
    47	    ((StableAffineOpen.gluedQuotientOverHomEquiv
    48	      (pic0SemilinearGalActionOfRepresentableBy C rep) T).trans
    49	      (pic0GaloisInvariantEquivGaloisEquivariantOver C rep T).symm).trans
    50	      (pic0GaloisInvariantEquiv (L := L) C T).symm
    51	  homEquiv_comp {T T'} f v := by
    52	    apply (pic0GaloisInvariantEquiv (L := L) C T).injective
    53	    apply (pic0GaloisInvariantEquivGaloisEquivariantOver C rep T).injective
    54	    simp only [Equiv.trans_apply, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    55	    rw [StableAffineOpen.gluedQuotientOverHomEquiv_precomp]
    56	    rw [pic0GaloisInvariantEquiv_precomp]
    57	    rw [pic0GaloisInvariantEquivGaloisEquivariantOver_precomp]
    58	    simp only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    59	
    60	end

     6	import Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Pullbacks

     9	/-!
    10	# Semilinear actions on schemes
    11	
    12	This is the scheme-level action vocabulary used by finite-Galois descent.  It
    13	matches the API of the quotient engine in the sibling Algebraic Jacobian
    14	project so that engine can be ported without a parallel set of conventions.
    15	
    16	The inversion in `toSpecAut` is forced by contravariance of `Spec` and by the
    17	group law on categorical automorphisms.  `SemilinearGalAction` then records an
    18	action on a scheme whose structural morphism covers this action on the base.
    19	
    20	## Main declarations
    21	
    22	* `AlgebraicJacobian.GaloisDescent.toSpecAut`: the action induced on a spectrum.
    23	* `AlgebraicJacobian.GaloisDescent.SemilinearGalAction`: a semilinear action on
    24	  a scheme over a field extension.
    25	* `SemilinearGalAction.OrbitsInAffineOpen`: the exact geometric condition used
    26	  by the scheme quotient construction.
    27	-/
    28	
    29	set_option autoImplicit false
    30	
    31	universe u
    32	
    33	open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry
    34	
    35	namespace AlgebraicJacobian.GaloisDescent
    36	
    37	section SpecAut
    38	
    39	variable (G : Type*) [Group G] (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    40	  [MulSemiringAction G A]
    41	
    42	lemma toRingHom_comp (gamma tau : G) :
    43	    (MulSemiringAction.toRingHom G A gamma).comp
    44	        (MulSemiringAction.toRingHom G A tau) =
    45	      MulSemiringAction.toRingHom G A (gamma * tau) :=
    46	  RingHom.ext fun x => (mul_smul gamma tau x).symm
    47	
    48	lemma toRingHom_one :
    49	    MulSemiringAction.toRingHom G A (1 : G) = RingHom.id A :=
    50	  RingHom.ext fun x => one_smul G x
    51	
    52	/-- A group acting on a commutative ring acts on its spectrum.  The inverse in
    53	the ring action makes this a group homomorphism after contravariance of `Spec`.
    54	-/
    55	noncomputable def toSpecAut : G →* Aut (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)) :=
    56	  MonoidHom.mk'
    57	    (fun gamma =>
    58	      { hom := Spec.map
    59	          (CommRingCat.ofHom (MulSemiringAction.toRingHom G A gamma⁻¹))
    60	        inv := Spec.map
    61	          (CommRingCat.ofHom (MulSemiringAction.toRingHom G A gamma))
    62	        hom_inv_id := by
    63	          rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, toRingHom_comp,
    64	            inv_mul_cancel, toRingHom_one, CommRingCat.ofHom_id, Spec.map_id]
    65	        inv_hom_id := by
    66	          rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, toRingHom_comp,
    67	            mul_inv_cancel, toRingHom_one, CommRingCat.ofHom_id, Spec.map_id] })
    68	    (fun gamma tau => by
    69	      refine Iso.ext ?_
    70	      change Spec.map
    71	          (CommRingCat.ofHom
    72	            (MulSemiringAction.toRingHom G A (gamma * tau)⁻¹)) =
    73	        Spec.map
    74	            (CommRingCat.ofHom
    75	              (MulSemiringAction.toRingHom G A tau⁻¹)) ≫
    76	          Spec.map
    77	            (CommRingCat.ofHom
    78	              (MulSemiringAction.toRingHom G A gamma⁻¹))
    79	      rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, toRingHom_comp,
    80	        ← mul_inv_rev])
    81	
    82	lemma toSpecAut_hom (gamma : G) :
    83	    (toSpecAut G A gamma).hom =
    84	      Spec.map
    85	        (CommRingCat.ofHom (MulSemiringAction.toRingHom G A gamma⁻¹)) :=
    86	  rfl
    87	
    88	lemma toSpecAut_mul_hom (gamma tau : G) :
    89	    (toSpecAut G A (gamma * tau)).hom =
    90	      (toSpecAut G A tau).hom ≫ (toSpecAut G A gamma).hom := by
    91	  rw [map_mul]
    92	  rfl
    93	
    94	lemma toSpecAut_inv_hom (gamma : G) :
    95	    (toSpecAut G A gamma⁻¹).hom = (toSpecAut G A gamma).inv := by
    96	  rw [map_inv]
    97	  rfl
    98	
    99	@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
   100	lemma toSpecAut_hom_inv_hom (gamma : G) :
   101	    (toSpecAut G A gamma).hom ≫ (toSpecAut G A gamma⁻¹).hom = 𝟙 _ := by
   102	  rw [toSpecAut_inv_hom, Iso.hom_inv_id]
   103	
   104	@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
   105	lemma toSpecAut_inv_hom_hom (gamma : G) :
   106	    (toSpecAut G A gamma⁻¹).hom ≫ (toSpecAut G A gamma).hom = 𝟙 _ := by
   107	  rw [toSpecAut_inv_hom, Iso.inv_hom_id]
   108	
   109	end SpecAut
   110	
   111	variable (K L : Type u) [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
   112	
   113	/-- A semilinear action of the `K`-algebra automorphisms of `L` on an
   114	`L`-scheme.  Each automorphism of the total space covers the corresponding
   115	automorphism of `Spec L`. -/
   116	structure SemilinearGalAction (X : Scheme.{u})
   117	    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)) where
   118	  act : (L ≃ₐ[K] L) →* Aut X
   119	  compat (gamma : L ≃ₐ[K] L) :
   120	    (act gamma).hom ≫ f =
   121	      f ≫ (toSpecAut (L ≃ₐ[K] L) L gamma).hom
   122	
   123	namespace SemilinearGalAction
   124	
   125	variable {K L} {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
   126	
   127	/-- Equivariance of a morphism between semilinearly acted schemes. -/
   128	def IsEquivariant {X' : Scheme.{u}}
   129	    {f' : X' ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
   130	    (rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f)
   131	    (rho' : SemilinearGalAction K L X' f') (h : X ⟶ X') : Prop :=
   132	  ∀ gamma : L ≃ₐ[K] L,
   133	    (rho.act gamma).hom ≫ h = h ≫ (rho'.act gamma).hom
   134	
   135	/-- The orbit of a point under a semilinear action. -/
   136	def orbit (rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f) (x : X) : Set X :=
   137	  Set.range fun gamma : L ≃ₐ[K] L => (rho.act gamma).hom.base x
   138	
   139	/-- The geometric condition required for the finite-Galois quotient to remain
   140	a scheme: every orbit lies in one affine open. -/
   141	class OrbitsInAffineOpen (rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f) : Prop where
   142	  exists_affineOpen (x : X) :
   143	    ∃ U : X.affineOpens,
   144	      ∀ gamma : L ≃ₐ[K] L, (rho.act gamma).hom.base x ∈ U.1
   145	
   146	/-- A stable open subset of a semilinearly acted scheme. -/
   147	def IsStableOpen (rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f) (U : X.Opens) : Prop :=
   148	  ∀ gamma : L ≃ₐ[K] L, (rho.act gamma).hom ⁻¹ᵁ U = U
   149	
   150	end SemilinearGalAction
   151	
   152	/-- A stable affine neighbourhood of every point.  The quotient engine derives
   153	this from `OrbitsInAffineOpen` for finite Galois extensions. -/
   154	class HasStableAffineCover {X : Scheme.{u}}
   155	    {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
   156	    (rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f) : Prop where
   157	  exists_stable_affineOpen (x : X) :
   158	    ∃ U : X.Opens, IsAffineOpen U ∧ x ∈ U ∧ rho.IsStableOpen U
   159	
   160	end AlgebraicJacobian.GaloisDescent

     7	import Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Morphisms.Affine
     8	
     9	/-!
    10	# Finite subsets in affine opens
    11	
    12	`Scheme.FiniteInAffine X` is the action-free geometric condition behind the
    13	finite-Galois quotient construction: every finite subset of `X` lies in one
    14	affine open.  For a finite Galois extension, this immediately supplies
    15	`SemilinearGalAction.OrbitsInAffineOpen` for every action on `X`.
    16	
    17	The property is stated independently of Picard data.  In particular, it is a
    18	conclusion to be proved for a representing scheme, not an additional field of
    19	the representability datum.
    20	-/
    21	
    22	set_option autoImplicit false
    23	
    24	universe u
    25	
    26	open CategoryTheory
    27	open AlgebraicJacobian.GaloisDescent
    28	
    29	namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme
    30	
    31	/-- Every finite subset of a scheme is contained in a single affine open. -/
    32	def FiniteInAffine (X : Scheme.{u}) : Prop :=
    33	  ∀ s : Set X, s.Finite → ∃ U : X.affineOpens, s ⊆ U.1
    34	
    35	/-- An affine scheme satisfies `FiniteInAffine`. -/
    36	theorem finiteInAffine_of_isAffine (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine X] :
    37	    FiniteInAffine X :=
    38	  fun _ _ ↦ ⟨⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top X⟩, fun _ _ ↦ trivial⟩
    39	
    40	/-- `FiniteInAffine` is invariant under isomorphism. -/
    41	theorem finiteInAffine_of_iso {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (e : X ≅ Y)
    42	    (h : FiniteInAffine X) : FiniteInAffine Y := by
    43	  intro s hs
    44	  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := h (e.hom.base ⁻¹' s)
    45	    (hs.preimage (TopCat.homeoOfIso ((Scheme.forgetToTop).mapIso e)).injective.injOn)
    46	  refine ⟨⟨e.hom ''ᵁ U.1, U.2.image_of_isOpenImmersion e.hom⟩, ?_⟩
    47	  intro y hy
    48	  exact ⟨e.inv.base y, hU (by simpa using hy), by simp⟩
    49	
    50	/-- `FiniteInAffine` descends along an affine morphism. -/
    51	theorem finiteInAffine_of_isAffineHom {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    52	    [IsAffineHom f] (h : FiniteInAffine Y) : FiniteInAffine X := by
    53	  intro s hs
    54	  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := h (f.base '' s) (hs.image _)
    55	  exact ⟨⟨f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1, U.2.preimage f⟩, fun x hx ↦ hU ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩⟩
    56	
    57	/-- An object affine over a field spectrum satisfies `FiniteInAffine`. -/
    58	theorem finiteInAffine_left_of_isAffineHom {k : Type u} [Field k]
    59	    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) [IsAffineHom X.hom] :
    60	    FiniteInAffine X.left :=
    61	  haveI := isAffine_of_isAffineHom X.hom
    62	  finiteInAffine_of_isAffine _
    63	
    64	/-- `FiniteInAffine` supplies the orbit condition for every finite-Galois
    65	semilinear action on the scheme. -/
    66	theorem orbitsInAffineOpen_of_finiteInAffine
    67	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    68	    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    69	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
    70	    (rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f) (h : FiniteInAffine X) :
    71	    rho.OrbitsInAffineOpen where
    72	  exists_affineOpen x := by
    73	    obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ :=
    74	      h (Set.range fun gamma : L ≃ₐ[K] L ↦ (rho.act gamma).hom.base x)
    75	        (Set.finite_range _)
    76	    exact ⟨U, fun gamma ↦ hU ⟨gamma, rfl⟩⟩
    77	
    78	end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme

No existing unconditional producer closes the gate.

The exact missing proposition is:

```lean
Scheme.FiniteInAffine P.glueData.glued
```

The best reusable producer to add is the full Stacks 0B7S theorem:

```lean
theorem GroupScheme.finiteInAffine_of_locallyOfFiniteType
    (G : Over (Spec (.of K))) [GrpObj G] [LocallyOfFiniteType G.hom] :
    Scheme.FiniteInAffine G.left
```

[GroupAffineOpen.lean](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild/AlgebraicJacobian/Descent/GroupAffineOpen.lean:162) already proves its algebraically closed, irreducible core and explicitly leaves arbitrary-field/reducible descent open.

At `P.gluedOver`, the remaining inputs are already available once `rep` exists:

- `GrpObj P.gluedOver` comes from `GrpObj.ofRepresentableBy`, exactly as in [PicRepDatum.lean](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild/AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/PicRepDatum.lean:108).
- `LocallyOfFiniteType P.gluedMap` is [instLocallyOfFiniteTypeGluedMap](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild/AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/Pic0FiniteStageGeometry.lean:49).
- [orbitsInAffineOpen_of_finiteInAffine](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild/AlgebraicJacobian/Descent/FiniteInAffine.lean:66) then produces the desired instance directly.

Thus [Pic0FiniteStageOrbitAffine.lean](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild/AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/Pic0FiniteStageOrbitAffine.lean:54) can gain a binder-free geometric producer from `rep`, without constructing projectivity or an immersion.

Search found no full group theorem or projectivity/quasi-projectivity fpqc-descent theorem in mathlib. The four commits only add conditional consumers: `5ee5a7f` requires projectivity, `7d861b2` requires an immersion, `da5bb57` proves only LFT and QC, and `679c29e` is the sibling project’s conditional H-quasi-projective route.

End-to-end representability still separately needs `RepresentableBy P.gluedOver`. Per I-2004, the current gluing-diagram draft and captured commit `aee6c39cf3` are unverified and must not be counted as that producer. No source files were edited.
